purpose: Replay completed docking matrices as if results arrived sequentially, testing whether a fixed-budget QUBO batch policy recovers early-recognition performance with fewer receptor-by-chemistry docking tasks.

BACE1.label_rule: high potency versus low potency; gray rows are routed but excluded from BEDROC

chemistry_batch_freeze.features: RDKit Morgan radius 2, 2048 bits, chirality disabled
chemistry_batch_freeze.algorithm: deterministic farthest-first medoid initialization followed by capacity-constrained Hungarian assignment and medoid refinement
chemistry_batch_freeze.capacity_rule: cluster sizes differ by at most one

replay.task: dock every ligand in one frozen chemistry batch against one receptor
replay.task_cost: number of ligands in the chemistry batch
replay.initial_observation: seed-specific cross design: all receptors on one anchor chemistry batch plus one anchor receptor on every remaining batch; anchors are selected by SHA-256(target_id, replay_seed) without labels or docking scores
replay.matrix_visibility: a policy may read a task's docking scores only after selecting that task
replay.label_visibility: labels are evaluation-only and never enter the surrogate or selector

surrogate.model: BayesianRidge on receptor and chemistry-batch one-hot effects
surrogate.observed_task_response: negative mean of the lowest-score quartile within the selected receptor-by-batch task

qubo_batch_objective.node_term: standardized 0.65 predictive mean plus 0.35 predictive standard deviation
qubo_batch_objective.redundancy: 0.5 if tasks share a receptor plus 0.5 times chemistry-batch centroid Tanimoto similarity
qubo_batch_objective.normalization: mean node utility minus 0.15 times mean selected-pair redundancy
qubo_batch_objective.exact_solver: scipy.optimize.milp linearization of the frozen QUBO
qubo_batch_objective.strong_classical: direct greedy followed by exhaustive one-swap on the same candidate QUBO

evaluation.aggregate_score: minimum observed docking score per ligand
evaluation.relative_recovery: (current BEDROC - initial BEDROC)/(full oracle BEDROC - initial BEDROC), reported with raw BEDROC and not used when the denominator is nonpositive

stop_rule: If the policy gate fails, do not tune weights, cluster counts, or budgets on these matrices. If policy value passes but solver value fails, retain adaptive docking as a classical application result and do not claim a quantum contribution.
